notes:
Summary: Cadenza is a mid-market SaaS vendor (ticketing + KB) building an agent-first support product. Focused on reducing live agent touches by 35% via RAG-based deflection and improving first-contact resolution.

Background / context:
- Dataset for POC: ~2.5M historical tickets + 0.8M KB entries (~3.3M docs); expect ~10M dense vectors after chunking (50–150 tokens).
- Expected steady-state QPS: 500–2,000 depending on rollout. Peak 3k qps for sales events.
- Latency SLOs: 95th perc < 150ms for retrieval+rerank end-to-end target for web chat; acceptable < 250ms for agent UI.
- Quality target: top-5 rerank precision >= 92% on held-out deflection test prompts.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per user query <$0.03 — must include embedding + retrieval + reranking.

Technical preferences / constraints:
- Prefer open embedding model quantized where possible; evaluate Redwood-verified embeddings and local quantized LLM reranker to reduce cross-region egress.
- Want hybrid retrieval: BM25 / sparse first-pass + ANN embeddings; then fast cross-encoder or light reranker only on top-20, final rerank on top-5.
- Data residency: EU customers require index/shard residency in EU region; some customers require no data egress (VPC/private).
- Security: SAML SSO, audit logs per request, KMS integration for encryption at rest.

Engagement history / timeline:
- 2025-10-02: Intro call (Ava) — high-level requirements, demo request.
- 2025-11-15: Technical deep-dive with infra + ML (SE: Daniel) — shared sample schema and volume estimates.
- 2026-01-08: Security questionnaire submitted; Cadenza requested SOC2, KMS details. (ticket SEC-3010 opened)
- 2026-01-18: Pricing deck v1 shared (drive link).
- 2026-02-10: Strategy call — agreed on POC scope (72h latency + rerank quality). Fireflies: ff_20260210_abc123.
- 2026-02-20: Legal follow-up re: residency; engineering flagged potential network constraints for private deployment.

POC scope and measurable milestones:
- Ingest subset: 500k docs + 250k tickets; produce embedding index and sparse index.
- Measure: cold-start retrieval latency distribution, end-to-end rerank latency (retrieve+rerank), compute cost per qps at 500/1k/2k qps.
- Evaluation: top-5 precision/recall vs. baseline BM25 and vendor X (Algolia).
- Deliverables: latency report, cost model, rerank precision report, production rollout recommendation (Dedicated vs Private).

Quotes / call notes:
- "We need the chat experience to feel instant — customers drop if answers take >200ms." — Head of Product.
- "If we can't hit the cost model we won't be able to scale to SMB plan." — CFO.

Next actions (short):

Open questions for Redwood:

Notes: customer is pragmatic, willing to trade slight hit in accuracy for >2x cost savings. Prioritizes latency over marginal quality gains when in chat path.
